basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of vibrant Mission Bay, this remodeled, light-filled 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers seamless indoor-outdoor living with two exclusive patios overlooking Mission Creek and Mission Creek Park. Floor-to-ceiling windows, radiant floor heating throughout, smart lighting control on a phone, and brand-new hardwood floors enhance the open layout. This beautifully upgraded home comes with a gourmet kitchen with ample storage and a breakfast bar. A patio off the dining area extends the living space outdoors. The spacious primary suite boasts custom closets and a luxurious marble bath, while the second bedroom offers a private view deck and its own expansive bath. The unit comes with 1 car parking with EV charger and storage cage located on the second floor. 255 Berry is a boutique building with a doorman, security, and a landscaped courtyard. Ideally located near Oracle Park, Chase Center, Mission Creek trails, top dining, and entertainment, with easy access to 101 & 280. Includes one parking space with an EV charger and storageMission Bay living at its best!
